data.body_html:
Imagine a full day on the water with your family, combining the thrill of a Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard 2031 — all on a single luxury charter. This 8-hour experience departs from Puerto Banús aboard a Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), includes a free jetski, snorkel gear, and a paddleboard, plus a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. No hidden costs, no extra fees. Just you, the Mediterranean, and a day your family will talk about for years.

What’s Included in the Family Combo

Every charter in our fleet comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For this specific combo, we also include:

  • Free jetski — one jetski for the duration of the charter (fuel included).
  • Snorkel gear — masks, fins, and snorkels for up to 12 guests.
  • Paddleboard — an inflatable stand-up paddleboard with pump and leash.

The rate is €4,719 for up to 12 guests for 8 hours (10:00–18:00). That works out to under €400 per person for a full day of luxury, water sports, and family fun.

Which Boat Is Best for Your Family?

The combo is available on two identical Mangusta 80 models: the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and the Mangusta 80 Grey (24m, 12 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and offer the same inclusions. The Mangusta 80 features a spacious flybridge, a large sundeck, a saloon with air conditioning, and a swim platform. It’s ideal for families because the layout allows kids to play safely while adults relax. For larger groups, consider the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) — these can be customised with a jetski add-on via WhatsApp.

Sample Itinerary: 8 Hours of Family Fun

Your skipper will tailor the route to sea conditions and your preferences. Here’s a typical day:

  • 10:00 — Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink and safety briefing.
  • 10:30 — Cruise east towards Cabopino. Kids can paddleboard in the calm bay.
  • 12:00 — Anchor at Cala del Faro for snorkelling and jetski rides.
  • 13:30 — Lunch on board (bring your own or order a picnic).
  • 15:00 — Head west to Cala Cortés for more paddleboarding and swimming.
  • 17:00 — Return cruise to Puerto Banús, with drinks and snacks.
  • 18:00 — Disembark.

All stops are within 10 NM of Puerto Banús, so you get maximum time in the water.

Why Choose a Family Boat Day in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers calm, sheltered coves perfect for families. The water temperature from June to October averages 22–26 °C, ideal for snorkelling and paddleboarding. Puerto Banús is the most convenient departure point, with free parking nearby and easy access to the Golden Mile. Unlike crowded beach clubs, a private charter gives you total freedom — stop when you want, play as long as you like, and never queue for a jetski or a sunbed.

For a full overview of all our boats and experiences, visit our Marbella boat rental hub.

Pricing and Booking

The flat rate for the Mangusta 80 family combo is €4,719 for 8 hours (up to 12 guests). This includes the jetski, snorkel gear, paddleboard, skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and tax. No surprises. To book, send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date and number of guests. We’ll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. A 50% deposit secures your booking; the balance is due 14 days before departure.

If you need a shorter charter, check our 2-hour boat hire or sunset cruise options.

Safety and Family-Friendly Policies

All our boats carry life jackets for every guest, including infants. The skipper holds a valid Spanish license and will brief everyone on safety before departure. The jetski is restricted to licensed drivers (minimum age 18) or supervised riders with a temporary license. Snorkelling and paddleboarding are at your own risk — we recommend non-swimmers wear life jackets at all times. We reserve the right to cancel or shorten the charter in adverse weather; in that case, a full refund or reschedule is offered.
